name: All I Want for Christmas Is You, the November 1 switch
sound: All I Want for Christmas Is You, Mariah Carey
what: The sound comes back on 1 Nov and creators use it to mark the switch from Halloween to Christmas: decorating, 'people on November 1st' jokes and booking pushes from service businesses.
origin: Released in 1994. The yearly 1 Nov return is tied to Mariah Carey's 'It's Time' post, and big early November posts sit on this sound from 2023, 2024 and 2025.
usage: 16.2M TikTok videos on the sound, lifetime, all years (5 Nov 2026), plus 4.7M on a second official sound id; 5.8M Reels all time per Postdom (2 Nov 2026); top post 126.6M views
brand_use: Salons, restaurants and gift shops show a December calendar filling up or a room being set for a party, ending on the date bookings close.
risk: The count covers every year, so it does not measure this season. Australian Christmas is in summer: swap snow and cosy scenes for heat, beach or backyard. Check the track is cleared for brand accounts.

notes: Counts read off the rendered sound pages on 5 Nov 2026. usage_n uses the larger sound id only; the two ids are not added together. Status follows SocialPilot's Reels stage ('Peak'); there is no earlier dated TikTok count to measure this season's growth. 2026 examples come from the 60 posts the sound page loaded, so a bigger 2026 post may exist. @glamour.au posted an 'it's timeeee' Australian version on 1 Nov (44.6K plays) but on its own original sound, so it is not listed.

name: November Rain
what: The song sits under moody clips with a short caption on TikTok. On Reels it runs under cinematic travel edits and 90s then-and-now memory montages.
origin: 1992 single. SocialPilot and Buffer both list it as a November sound, and SocialPilot says it returns every year. On TikTok the biggest 2026 posts started before the month, from late Sep.
usage: 282.8K TikTok videos on the sound, lifetime, all years (5 Nov 2026); 322K Reels per SocialPilot (Oct 31 to Nov 10 list); top post 11.3M views
brand_use: A year-in-review cut to the guitar solo, or a heritage brand showing old and new with the year on screen. Car, travel and vintage retail suit it best.
risk: The month joke ends on 30 Nov. Top TikTok posts lean sad and relationship-themed and many have no link to November, so the mood may not fit a cheerful brand. Rainy-window edits read oddly going into an Australian summer. Check the track is cleared for brand accounts.

name: Santa Tell Me countdown
what: The early countdown sound, used for 'it's nearly time' clips, gift ideas, advent calendar unboxings and Christmas hair and decorating.
origin: Released in 2014. SocialPilot counted ten Reels on its audio page posted 26 to 29 Oct 2026, mostly countdown clips.
usage: 237.5K TikTok videos on the sound, lifetime, all years (5 Nov 2026); 571K Reels per SocialPilot (Oct 31 to Nov 10 list); top post 125.2M views
brand_use: Cafes, candle shops and beauty brands film the first Christmas drink or gift set in close-up, or open an advent calendar on the beat.
risk: The count covers every year. Winter-styled versions do not fit an Australian summer, so use light, heat and outdoor settings. Check the track is cleared for brand accounts.

name: Underneath the Tree reveals
what: The upbeat Christmas launch sound: tree reveals, decor going up and venue openings on Reels, with days-until-Christmas posts on TikTok.
origin: Released in 2013. SocialPilot calls it the brand-launch sound of the season, with the hook 'Christmas starts November 1'. On TikTok, big 2026 posts began in mid Sep.
usage: 49.4K TikTok videos on the sound, lifetime, all years (5 Nov 2026); 451K Reels per SocialPilot (Oct 31 to Nov 10 list); top post 40M views
brand_use: Show a bare shop floor or tree going to fully styled in five cuts, ending on the opening date or a comment keyword for the link.
risk: The count covers every year. The sound is far bigger on Reels than TikTok, so lead there. Keep reveals bright and summery for Australia. Check the track is cleared for brand accounts.

name: Mariah 'It's Time' 2026 sound
sound: original sound, Mariah Carey (2026 'It's Time' post)
what: Creators reuse the audio from Mariah Carey's 2026 'It's Time' post to announce that Christmas has started, often with something 'defrosted' on screen.
origin: Posted by @mariahcarey on 1 Nov 2026, tagged as a Sol de Janeiro partnership. The yearly post follows her 'defrosting' meme.
usage: 4,749 TikTok videos on the sound (5 Nov 2026), all this season; top post 42.4M views, 8.8M likes
brand_use: Defrost a mascot, product or shop sign and cut to the Christmas range, as @pizzahutsv did. Only worth doing in the next week or so.
risk: The biggest posts are all from 1 Nov, so the joke is already ageing. The 30 Nov end date is a judgement call. The source post is a paid partnership and the audio is Mariah Carey's, so check clearance before a business account uses it.
notes: Small sound count but only five days old, and the only entry whose count is all 2026. Overlaps with entry 1, which covers the song; this one is the audio of the 2026 post. Status is a judgement from post dates on the sound page, with no second dated count to compare. Other 'it's time' posts sit on creators' own original sounds and are not counted.
